Name: Nixx-Ymir
Description: Download, update, launch, BIOS, save and compatibility integration for Ymir, the Sega Saturn emulator: one save per game, several discs, the pack's keys, and each game's state in Ymir's compatibility list.
Credits: Many thanks to StrikerX3 and the Ymir team, and to the testers of Ymir's compatibility list.
